conviction_note: A non-result. Tieto publishes its own Modular Finance consensus (10 of 13 analysts, last updated 2026-10-21): Q3 revenue EUR 400m, organic growth -9.0%, adjusted EBITA EUR 65m, margin 16.2%; FY margin 15.6% inside the 14.8-15.8% guide. No inside-information release or profit warning has been filed since the Q2 report. The 20-day run-up is the IT-services rally that followed Accenture's 1 October guide, which leaves the stock 14% above the mean target. Peer read-through is mixed: Knowit is up on margin but calls Finland the weakest market; Vincit and Columbus are soft. The findings net to 0.0, and the scaled number of -0.28 is a slight valuation lean on an unsigned 7% move. That move is set by new Q3 numbers and a likely narrowing of the guide, and by this name's own non-pre-released results days: -13.0%, +10.4%, +14.0%, -0.9%.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 adj EBITA vs EUR 65m / 16.2% consensus; headline organic growth around -9% and EBITA down roughly 26% YoY because of the court-ruling comparison, both already in consensus. Direction unknown.

Likely narrowing of the FY ranges with one quarter left. Consensus margin of 15.6% sits in the upper half of 14.8-15.8%, so narrowing toward the midpoint would disappoint and 15.3-15.8% would be in line. The growth range is likely narrowed toward -5%..-4%, in line with -4.6% consensus. Direction unknown.

Next phase of the H2 workforce adjustment flagged in July: possible restructuring charges (below adjusted EBITA) and possibly savings beyond the EUR 130m run-rate target. Mildly positive if it comes with a number.
Q2 operating cash flow fell to EUR 20.8m from 51.3m; Q3 cash flow is unknown and is a possible Luceco-type line.
Q4 demand commentary for Tech Consulting (Finland weak per Knowit) and Banktech legacy-contract runoff. Unknown.

findings.finding: Tieto has filed no inside-information or guidance-change release since the H1 report: the Nasdaq Nordic feed back to 2026-08-31 shows only buybacks, share cancellations and the CFO appointment. The company's record (Aug 2025 ruling notice, Nov 2025 margin raise, Jul 2026 growth cut) is to pre-announce when it moves off its range, so the FY ranges are presumably intact. Consensus (15.6% margin, -4.6% organic) sits inside them.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide moves have been the big days: +2.4% on the Nov 2025 margin raise, -3.0% on the Jul 2026 growth cut, +10.4% on Q3 2025 and +14.0% on Q4 2025 (both with outlook and buyback news)
findings.original_quote: Tieto pitää vuoden 2026 kannattavuusnäkymänsä ennallaan. (Tieto keeps its 2026 profitability outlook unchanged, 17.7.2026)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. It only bounds the downside tail; consensus already sits inside the range. If the market doubted the guide, consensus would sit at the bottom of the range and the stock would not be 14% above the mean target.
findings.independence: The consensus file shows analysts at 15.6% FY margin inside the guide: https://widget.datablocks.se/api/rose/widgets/kpi-export-v2?token=20b19204-74c3-43e6-8508-b8fefdd2d5bb

findings.finding: Nordic IT-services peers that reported Q3 in the last week give a mixed read. Knowit (23 Oct, +20% on the day) improved profitability, said Norway is developing strongly and called Finland its most challenging market. Columbus returned to 6% growth but cut its margin guide. Vincit's revenue fell 12% and it said decision-making remains slow.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Tieto rose +1.95% on the day Knowit reported, so the read-through was taken immediately
findings.why_not_priced: Already traded: Tieto +1.95% on 23 Oct and +2.47% on 26 Oct. The read cuts both ways for Tech Consulting (Finland weak, Norway strong) and says nothing about Banktech or Caretech software, so it nets to zero.

findings.finding: The stock rose 12.6% from EUR 18.06 (30 Sep) to EUR 20.34 (26 Oct) in the IT-services re-rating after Accenture's 1 October FY27 guide. It now trades 14.3% above the mean sell-side target of EUR 17.37, with 8 holds, 2 sells and 2 buys, so an in-line print gives analysts no reason to chase.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean precedent. The Jun-Jul 2026 slide (-6.9%, -5.7%, -4.7% days) came before the July growth cut.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the run-up is the free control and sits in priced_lean (-0.53). What the run-up alone does not show is that the rally is sector-driven (https://www.trefis.com/stock/acn/articles2/619002/why-did-accenture-stock-jump/2026-10-16) and not Tieto-specific, and that targets have not followed. Sized small because a lean that agrees with the run-up is mostly in the price.

findings.finding: The Q3 2025 comparison contains EUR 21.9m of SpareBank 1 court-ruling revenue at near-full margin, so the Q3 2026 headline will show organic growth around -9% and adjusted EBITA down from EUR 87.8m. Consensus already models both (-9.0%, EUR 65m), but the wire headline will read badly.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: consensus at -9.0% organic shows analysts model it. The only residual is a headline-reading open on the wires, so the size is near zero.

findings.finding: The H1 report said Tieto would adjust its workforce in H2 for the next phase of its renewal (cost programme target EUR 130m run-rate by end-2026). Q3 is the first report where the size of that step can appear, as restructuring charges below adjusted EBITA and possibly as savings beyond the target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cost-programme news coincided with the +10.4% (Q3 2025) and +14.0% (Q4 2025) days
findings.original_quote: sopeutamme työvoimaa yhtiön uudistamisen seuraavaa vaihetta tukevalla tavalla. Tätä työtä jatkamme vuoden jälkipuoliskolla. (we are adjusting the workforce to support the next phase of the company's renewal; we will continue this work in the second half)
findings.why_not_priced: The direction is public but the size is not: no muutosneuvottelut (change negotiations) notice or other number has been filed in Finland, Sweden or Norway. Mostly an inference, so small.
findings.independence: EUR 130m savings target per the Q2 summary: https://quartr.com/events/tieto-oyj-tieto-q2-2026_3Y1zs0Gu

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The buyback announcement days (Feb 2026 EUR 150m programme) sat on the +14.0% day; the steady programme has no separable reaction

baseline_tension: The lean is -0.53, driven by the run-up. What I found mostly agrees with it, through the sector-driven run-up and the stock 14% above target, and is offset by the intact guide and the buyback, so the findings net to 0.0 and the scaled number leans only slightly negative.
language_note: The Finnish-language release of 22.7.2026 carries the H2 workforce-adjustment sentence ('sopeutamme työvoimaa ... jatkamme vuoden jälkipuoliskolla') verbatim. The English summaries I found (Quartr) paraphrase it as 'cost base reshaping' without the H2 timing.

Inderes, the main Finnish-language independent coverage, ended its Tieto coverage in February 2026 (tiedon-yhtioseuranta-paattyy), so there is no domestic-language preview this quarter. That is an absence, not information.
Otherwise nothing the English sources did not already carry: Tieto publishes every release in Finnish and English simultaneously, and the consensus and filings were identical in both.
lessons_applied: 'Move is in the guide' and 'too small about the move': abs_move_pct raised from 6.5 to 7.0. Q3 numbers are not pre-released and a guide narrowing is likely, and the name's own non-pre-released results days moved -13.0%, +10.4%, +14.0% and -0.9%.
'A number the market has already been told is worth 0': the court-ruling base-effect finding cut from -0.2 to -0.1, because consensus already models -9% organic.
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not agree with': the valuation/run-up finding cut from -0.5 to -0.3, because it mostly restates the run-up lean.
Lands inside the guide: the no-warning finding cut from +0.3 to +0.2.
'Proxy/inference is a hypothesis': the workforce-adjustment finding cut from +0.2 to +0.1.
